name: Collation MCP Server
description:
Collation sets up and manages a dedicated data warehouse for your investment data, then connects Claude directly to it. Your portfolios, positions, transactions, and performance data stay in your own warehouse — Claude queries it in place so you get answers without exporting or moving anything.
Ask questions in plain language and Claude will run SQL against your warehouse, pull up dashboards, and reuse your saved queries.
Key capabilities:

Run SQL and explore tables across your own data warehouse
Calculate time-weighted returns (TWR) for any portfolio or period
Access and build on your saved queries and dashboards
Browse schema and documentation to understand what's available

Built for wealth managers, analysts, and operations teams who want fast, accurate answers from investment data they fully own and control.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Collation MCP Server to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Collation MCP Server to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcpserver.collation.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Collation MCP Server MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Collation MCP Server lists 15 MCP tools, including calculate_twr, create_saved_query, describe_table, get_dashboard, list_dashboards, list_databases, list_documentation, list_saved_queries, list_tables, read_documentation, run_saved_query, and run_sql.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Collation MCP Server?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Collation MCP Server in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Collation MCP Server MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Collation MCP Server requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Collation MCP Server is developed by Collation. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
